svg.title: Paarth Katole — AI Systems / Analytics / Forecasting
svg.desc: UCLA MSBA · IIT Bombay. I work across AI systems, analytics, and forecasting. I like the part where a model becomes something you actually use and the questions that come up when the data refuses to cooperate. Toolbox: AI systems — LangGraph, LangChain, RAG / vector search, LLM APIs. Analytics — Python, SQL, R, Tableau, Power BI. Forecasting and modeling — scikit-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM. Pipelines and platforms — PySpark, dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, Snowflake. Exploration and delivery — Jupyter, Streamlit, Git.

g.text: Turning messy data into useful decisions
